'''Jimmy Marbels''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He ran away from his home to find his brother, [[Johnny Marbels|Johnny]], who was a [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. At the age of eight, he encountered the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] and asked to fly his [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="RPG" />
